instruction: How to add stick-table to HAProxy config for persistence
output: echo 'backend web-backend stick-table type ip size 1k expire 30m stick on src' >> /etc/haproxy/haproxy.cfg

instruction: How to show all HAProxy frontends via socket
output: echo 'show frontend' | socat unix-connect:/var/run/haproxy.sock stdio

instruction: How to check HAProxy version
output: haproxy -v

instruction: How to add custom error file in HAProxy
output: echo 'errorfile 503 /etc/haproxy/errors/503.http' >> /etc/haproxy/haproxy.cfg

instruction: How to start HAProxy with a config file
output: haproxy -f /etc/haproxy/haproxy.cfg

instruction: How to set up HAProxy with multiple backends
output: echo 'backend web-backend balance roundrobin server web01 10.0.0.1:80 check server web02 10.0.0.2:80 check' >> /etc/haproxy/haproxy.cfg

instruction: How to disable a server from HAProxy via socket
output: echo 'disable server web-backend/web01' | socat unix-connect:/var/run/haproxy.sock stdio

instruction: How to show HAProxy pools via socket
output: echo 'show pools' | socat unix-connect:/var/run/haproxy.sock stdio

instruction: How to show HAProxy errors via socket
output: echo 'show errors' | socat unix-connect:/var/run/haproxy.sock stdio

instruction: How to show all HAProxy backends via socket
output: echo 'show backend' | socat unix-connect:/var/run/haproxy.sock stdio

instruction: How to show HAProxy stick-table contents
output: echo 'show table web-backend' | socat unix-connect:/var/run/haproxy.sock stdio

instruction: How to configure HAProxy with backup server
output: echo 'server web01 10.0.0.1:80 check server web02 10.0.0.2:80 check backup' >> /etc/haproxy/haproxy.cfg

instruction: How to show HAProxy server state via socket
output: echo 'show servers state' | socat unix-connect:/var/run/haproxy.sock stdio

instruction: How to show HAProxy stats via socket
output: echo 'show stat' | socat unix-connect:/var/run/haproxy.sock stdio

instruction: How to set up HAProxy ACL for path-based routing
output: echo 'acl is_api path_beg -i /api use_backend api-backend if is_api default_backend web-backend' >> /etc/haproxy/haproxy.cfg

instruction: How to add an ACL entry via socket in HAProxy
output: echo 'add acl /etc/haproxy/whitelist.lst 10.0.0.1' | socat unix-connect:/var/run/haproxy.sock stdio

instruction: How to set up HAProxy logging to a specific facility
output: echo 'global log /dev/log local0 info log /dev/log local1 notice' > /etc/haproxy/logging.cfg

instruction: How to enable a server in HAProxy via socket
output: echo 'enable server web-backend/web01' | socat unix-connect:/var/run/haproxy.sock stdio

instruction: How to connect to HAProxy stats socket
output: echo 'show info' | socat unix-connect:/var/run/haproxy.sock stdio

instruction: How to set up HAProxy ACL for domain-based routing
output: echo 'acl is_app hdr_dom(host) app.example.com use_backend app-backend if is_app' >> /etc/haproxy/haproxy.cfg

instruction: How to set server weight in HAProxy via socket
output: echo 'set server web-backend/web01 weight 50' | socat unix-connect:/var/run/haproxy.sock stdio

instruction: How to put server in maintenance mode in HAProxy
output: echo 'set server web-backend/web01 state maint' | socat unix-connect:/var/run/haproxy.sock stdio
